summary.business_type: Local Service — River Rafting & Adventure Tourism (Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India)
top_findings: Fabricated-looking testimonials: all 3 homepage reviews share one stock avatar image from a demo template, generic 5-star ratings — needs explicit client sign-off before launch
Homepage stat counters ('Happy Rafters', 'Rafting Routes') render as 0/0+ in server-rendered HTML — indistinguishable from an unfinished placeholder
Pervasive thin content: homepage ~200 words (floor 500), all 6 package pages 199-236 words (floor 800), all 3 blog posts 227-268 words (floor 1,500)

Package pricing has no reliable machine-readable home anywhere — missing from schema on the pages that sell each route, misallocated to a homepage ItemList that doesn't match on-page content, and absent from AI-crawler text extraction
Malformed BlogPosting.image URL (double-prefixed absolute Unsplash URL) confirmed broken today on all 3 blog posts, found independently by two audits
quick_wins: Fix the one-line blog schema image bug (guard against double-prefixing an absolute URL)
Fix oversized header logo (~85KB wasted per page load, sitewide, one component change)
Add Next.js priority prop to hero images on 4 templates to fix LCP 'Needs Improvement'
Enlarge 'Book Now' package-card tap target from ~16px to 48px+ (core conversion action)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 18 pages return HTTP 200, unique titles/meta descriptions/canonicals, single H1 each
Fully SSR/prerendered (X-Nextjs-Prerender: 1) — no JS execution required for crawlers to see content
Canonical tags and sitemap already correctly point to the production domain, not the preview host
HSTS well-configured; HTTP->HTTPS and trailing-slash redirects are clean single 308 hops
Custom 404 returns a real HTTP 404 status, not a soft-404

findings.title: Sitewide noindex/robots Disallow must be removed before production launch
findings.description: robots.txt currently has Disallow: / and every page carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">. Correct and expected for this pre-launch preview; catastrophic if shipped unchanged to the production domain. Excluded from the numeric score by design.
findings.recommendation: Tie both rules to a single VERCEL_ENV === 'production' check so one deploy flips both. Treat as the top launch-day action item.

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy on any response (HSTS is present and strong).
findings.recommendation: Add via next.config.js headers() or a Vercel vercel.json headers block.

findings.title: 4 homepage images missing alt text
findings.description: 4 of 25 sampled homepage images have no alt attribute at all (not decorative alt="").
findings.recommendation: Full-site image alt audit before launch.

findings.title: robots.txt has no Sitemap: directive
findings.description: Independent of the current Disallow rule — a real gap that's easy to forget once the Disallow is removed.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Sitemap: https://www.shivalikgangaadventure.com/sitemap.xml' now.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Package-page prose (itineraries, inclusions/exclusions, route descriptions) reads as legitimate, operator-specific copy, not generic filler
Real, route-specific rapid names and grade-appropriate safety detail (kayak escort, senior crew on Grade IV)
Privacy/Terms pages are genuinely business-specific, not generic legal boilerplate
Real NAP (address, phone, email, hours) present and consistent

findings.title: Testimonials use a shared stock/template demo avatar, not real customer photos
findings.description: All 3 homepage testimonials point to the identical avatar file (a demo asset from the underlying HTML template), with generic names and 5-star ratings on every quote.
findings.recommendation: Confirm with the client before launch whether these are real, consenting customers. Replace with real reviews or remove until real ones exist.

findings.title: Homepage stat counters render as 0
findings.description: 'Numbers That Speak for Themselves' (Happy Rafters, Rafting Routes, etc.) render 0/0+ in static server-rendered HTML with no real target value found.
findings.recommendation: Verify real numbers are wired into the count-up animation before launch, or remove the section.

findings.title: Pervasive thin content across every page type
findings.description: Homepage ~200 words (floor 500), 6 package pages 199-236 words each (floor 800), 3 blog posts 227-268 words each (floor 1,500). Topical depth (FAQ breadth, gear/logistics detail, local specifics) is shallow throughout.
findings.recommendation: Expand each page type toward its floor with genuinely new detail, not padding.

findings.title: No named certification/licensing authority
findings.description: Copy repeatedly claims 'certified guides' without naming who certifies them (Uttarakhand Tourism registration, IRF affiliation, first-aid body).
findings.recommendation: Add a real registration/license number and named certifying body — standard practice for legitimate Rishikesh rafting operators.

findings.title: Blog posts have no author byline or credentials
findings.description: Safety-adjacent content (rapid grading, seasonal safety judgment calls) has zero visible author attribution.
findings.recommendation: Add an attributed, credentialed author (e.g. 'Written by [Name], Lead Rafting Guide').

findings.title: Manufactured urgency copy reads as synthetic
findings.description: 'Limited slots per day... hurry and reserve your raft' style copy isn't tied to any real, verifiable live data.
findings.recommendation: Tie to real data or remove; generic scarcity language risks reading as manipulative.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 100% unique titles and meta descriptions across all 18 pages
Single H1 per page sitewide
Clean, human-readable, hyphenated URL structure with no IDs or query strings
Strong package-detail page template: price, duration, distance, grade, group size, itinerary, inclusions/exclusions, and FAQ all above the fold

findings.title: Homepage H1 omits the location keyword
findings.description: H1 is 'Find Your Perfect Rafting Adventure Today' — generic; Rishikesh/Ganga appear in title/body but not the H1 itself.
findings.recommendation: Include the location in the H1 to match dominant SERP pattern for this query cluster.

findings.title: /packages listing lacks decision-support content
findings.description: 187 words total across 6 package cards with no 'which package is right for you' guidance or grade explainer for a comparison-stage searcher.
findings.recommendation: Add persona-routing copy and a Grade I-IV explainer.

findings.title: Best existing AI/SEO asset (Grade II vs IV blog post) is under-linked
findings.description: Only reachable via /blog despite being a strong comparison-style answer for 'which grade should I book' queries.
findings.recommendation: Cross-link from /packages and each package page's FAQ.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Site-wide SportsActivityLocation + TouristAttraction + BreadcrumbList via app/layout.tsx, fully server-rendered
FAQPage on all 6 package pages, BlogPosting on all 3 posts — valid structure, no deprecated types
FAQPage correctly retained (not removed) despite Google's May 2026 FAQ rich-result retirement, for its AI-citation value

findings.title: No TouristTrip/Offer schema on package detail pages
findings.description: The 6 pages that actually sell trips carry only Breadcrumb + FAQ — price/duration/grade shown on-page isn't represented in structured data there at all.
findings.recommendation: Add TouristTrip + Offer schema per package page. Generated code provided in findings/schema.md.

findings.title: Malformed BlogPosting.image URL
findings.description: getBlogPostingSchema double-prefixes COMPANY.url onto an already-absolute Unsplash coverImage URL, producing a broken image field today.
findings.recommendation: Guard with post.coverImage.startsWith('http') before prefixing.

findings.title: ItemList content mismatch on homepage
findings.description: Home's ItemList enumerates all 6 packages, but the homepage itself only renders 3 (PopularTours limit={3}) — violates Google's content-matches-markup guidance.
findings.recommendation: Move the full 6-item ItemList to /packages, which does render all 6.

findings.title: BlogPosting missing publisher
findings.description: No Organization+logo publisher property, needed for full Article rich-result/AI attribution eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add publisher object per findings/schema.md §4b.

findings.title: No Review/AggregateRating schema
findings.description: A populated testimonials section exists but isn't expressed as structured data.
findings.recommendation: Ship only once testimonial authenticity is confirmed by the client — fabricated reviews in schema carry spam-action risk.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS measured at 0.000 on all 5 tested pages
TTFB excellent everywhere (39-59ms, Vercel edge)
TBT/INP-proxy comfortably 'Good' on every page (45-138ms)
AVIF image delivery already working correctly via Vercel Image Optimizer

findings.title: 4 of 5 pages miss 'Good' LCP threshold
findings.description: Home (3.12s), Package Detail (3.09s), Gallery (3.56s), Blog (3.44s) all land in the 2.5-4.0s 'Needs Improvement' band under simulated mobile throttling; only /packages (1.81s) passes. Lab data only, no CrUX field data available pre-launch.
findings.recommendation: Fix the oversized logo and missing priority hints below first, then re-measure.

findings.title: Hero/LCP images not marked fetchpriority=high
findings.description: The hero image is eagerly loaded but not prioritized on Packages, Package Detail, Gallery, and Blog.
findings.recommendation: Add the Next.js priority prop to the hero/cover Image component on each template.

findings.title: Header logo served ~40x larger than needed on every page
findings.description: Requested at w=2048 (native 1006x1024px) but displayed at 55x56px — 86.8 KB wasted per page load, and incorrectly loading=lazy on an above-fold element.
findings.recommendation: Constrain the sizes prop to the actual rendered box; remove loading=lazy.

findings.title: Card/grid images oversized relative to display size
findings.description: Systemic sizes misconfiguration — up to 187 KB wasted on the Blog page alone.
findings.recommendation: Set sizes to match actual rendered width at each breakpoint across all card/grid Image usages.

findings.title: Hotlinked Unsplash images for package/blog cover art
findings.description: External hotlinking is a production risk (rate limits, hotlink policy) with no preconnect hint.
findings.recommendation: Replace with self-hosted, pre-optimized assets before real launch.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Fully SSR/prerendered site (is_spa: false on all 18 pages) — the strongest technical foundation this audit found for AI crawlers
100% consistent brand naming across all 18 pages, aiding LLM entity attribution
The Grade II vs Grade IV blog post already reads like a ready-made comparison answer for AI Overviews/Perplexity

findings.title: FAQ answers absent from extractable text for 2 of every 3 questions
findings.description: Only the open accordion question's answer exists in the DOM; the other two are React-state-only, invisible to non-JS-executing crawlers. 18 of 24 FAQ answers across 6 package pages are affected.
findings.recommendation: Render all FAQ answers into the DOM at all times using native <details> or CSS-toggle instead of conditional JSX.

findings.title: Price missing from extractable body text on all 6 package pages
findings.description: Price lives in a sidebar that boilerplate-stripping pipelines (used by ChatGPT/Perplexity-style browsing tools) drop entirely.
findings.recommendation: State price once in main-content prose in addition to the schema fix.

findings.title: Package comparison collapses to 1-of-6 under text extraction
findings.description: Only the first package card's grade/duration/distance/price survives extraction on /packages; the other 5 are stripped as repeated boilerplate.
findings.recommendation: Add a real <table> comparison block outside the repeated card components.

findings.title: No llms.txt and no AI-crawler-specific robots.txt allowlist
findings.description: Current robots.txt is a hardcoded blanket block with no per-crawler rules queued for launch day.
findings.recommendation: Ship the recommended production robots.txt and llms.txt templates in findings/geo.md.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Next/Image AVIF conversion working correctly across all sampled images
Above-the-fold hero images are eager-loaded (not lazy), which is correct for LCP candidates

findings.title: Header logo served far larger than its rendered size
findings.description: ~85 KB wasted per page load, sitewide, plus incorrectly lazy-loaded despite being always-visible.
findings.recommendation: Fix sizes prop and remove loading=lazy on the logo component.

findings.title: Widespread missing width/height/aspect-ratio on images
findings.description: 20/25 images on Home, 14/16 on Packages, 8/10 on Package Detail lack explicit dimensions or CSS aspect-ratio — a structural CLS-risk pattern (proxy check, not a live CLS measurement).
findings.recommendation: Audit image components for explicit sizing across all page templates.

findings.title: Generic, non-descriptive gallery alt text
findings.description: Alt text reads as 'rafting moment 1', 'rafting video clip 3' rather than naming the specific rapid/route shown.
findings.recommendation: Write descriptive, location-specific alt text once real trip photography replaces Unsplash placeholders.

items: Remove robots.txt Disallow: / and add Sitemap: + AI-crawler allowlist
Remove sitewide noindex,nofollow meta tag
Add /llms.txt
Re-verify all 18 sitemap URLs return 200 on the live production host
Claim and verify Google Business Profile with matching NAP
Client sign-off on testimonial authenticity
Client sign-off on stat counter values
Add licensing/insurance copy to /about

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix malformed BlogPosting.image URL bug
Add TouristTrip/Offer schema to all 6 package detail pages
Move/duplicate ItemList schema to /packages
Render all FAQ answers into the DOM at all times
Add a real comparison table to /packages
State package price in main-content prose

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Enlarge Book Now tap targets to 48px+
Fix oversized header logo
Add priority prop to hero images
Add publisher property to BlogPosting schema
Add named certification/licensing authority to copy
Add author byline/credentials to blog posts
Expand blog posts to 600-900+ words
Fix images missing explicit dimensions (CLS risk)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand package page FAQs to 3-5 questions each
Add decision-support copy to /packages
Add Review/AggregateRating schema (post sign-off)
Add logo property and entity linking to LocalBusiness schema
Increase geo coordinate precision
Add Maps embed to /about and /destinations
Set up post-trip review-generation workflow
Register on TripAdvisor, JustDial, GetYourGuide/Viator
Fix sizes misconfiguration on card/grid images
Replace hotlinked Unsplash images
Add security headers

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Re-run performance audit against production with real CrUX field data
Watch Gallery page Total Blocking Time as image count grows
Monitor review velocity post-launch
Add descriptive alt text once real trip photography ships
Re-audit Local SEO and GEO categories 4-6 weeks post-launch
Implement IndexNow
